capabilities: Plays vault audio files (mp3, wav, ogg, m4a, flac, aac) in the sidebar
Syncs LRC and word-level karaoke lyrics with timestamp citation deep links
Applies 10-band equalizer, gapless crossfade, and ReplayGain normalization
Manages library, favorites, rule-based smart playlists, and folder-synced playlists
Edits ID3/Vorbis metadata and companion .lrc files, logging plays to Daily Notes
extras: Manifest mentions audio bookmarks, but the README documents no bookmark feature. README includes fork comparison and benchmark tables, BRAT install option, and sponsorship requests; no troubleshooting section.
intentEvidence: Liber Music Player was forked from TracingOrigins/obsidian-music-player-plugin (v1.3.8).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse and play local audio with synced lyrics, loudness normalization, or playback DSP, so vault music needs an external app.

relations.evidence: Liber Music Player was forked from TracingOrigins/obsidian-music-player-plugin (v1.3.8).
